title: Stop Killing Turtles
description: This datapack makes it so there are SEVERE consequences for attacking sea turtles.
body:
# **Stop Killing Turtles**

**Sea turtles (and all turtles, except Minecraft only has sea turtles) do not deserve to die.**

This datapack enforces the rule that sea turtles should not be attacked, and lets everyone know that the blood of sea turtles, is on your hands.

When you attack a sea turtle, tons of horrible potion effects will be applied to you.

I don't recommend finding out for yourself
...
Or there WILL be consequences.
